sources.title: Spirit Quake Maps GPL
sources.notes: Author explicitly publishes only his own map geometry under GPL and says assets/textures must be replaced. Excellent geometry/layout donor source for original zombie conversions.

sources.title: Quetoo Editable Map Sources
sources.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 repo level, per-map audit required
sources.notes: Repository ships editable map sources, textures, models and map docs. Includes both original maps and remakes of id maps; use only individually audited original designs.

sources.title: Simple AFPS Level
sources.notes: Original CC0 low-poly Quake-style arena. Less convenient than .map but completely clean prototype geometry.

sources.title: RBDOOM-3-BFG CC0 Test Maps
sources.notes: CC0 custom test maps. Better as conversion/renderer workflow examples than finished zombie maps.

sources.title: GoldSrc Map Sources Restored
sources.notes: Sources were reconstructed from commercial GoldSrc BSPs. Repository license cannot automatically clear underlying commercial map rights. Do NOT ship these as Enhanced maps; use only to study toolchains/brush repair.

sources.title: vmf2map Conversion Tool
sources.notes: Useful for author-permitted Source VMF maps such as a Nuketown blockout/source. Displacements become normal brushes.

sources.title: NZ:P Toolbox
sources.notes: Official NZ:P tooling can create new .map templates and build .map -> BSP through the full pipeline including Spawn Zone generation.
